validity_findings.finding: Synthetic alias-OOD task graph is minimal derived dict where headers_observed/body_observed/url_query directly contain the expected aliased key/value (e.g., Authorization:Bearer, X-Api-Key, api_token) not present in any registry template. Genuine reconstruction reduces to 'adopt any observed key not in registry and rewrite template via alphabetically-sorted multi-adoption' (research/frontier/run_genuine_35773143736.py:choose_adoptions+rewrite_template_multi). This is structurally isomorphic to copying the answer from observation. Success does not demonstrate semantic intent resolution beyond key-presence copying; synthetic-to-real gap dominates. Channel isolation diagnostics (RULE-URL-ONLY 0.0, BODY-ONLY 0.25, HEADERS-ONLY 0.5) show pooled 1.0 requires joint handling but still within same copy mechanism. Do not generalize to noisy DOM/AX, visual layout, timing, auth/session drift.
validity_findings.evidence: tasks.json:derived_context headers_observed/body_observed equality to hidden_expected.expected_bound, run_genuine_35773143736.py:286-320 choose_adoptions, derived_metrics.json:channel_isolation_diagnostics, prereg section 2 validity notes

validity_findings.finding: RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED confidence definition is model-derived softmax over learned candidate logits + rewrite logit with learned temperature (softplus inv_temp) for tasks with candidates, but falls back to structural constant 0.05+hash-jitter for no-candidate tasks (no-applicable 12, empty 6). ECE overall 0.0518 mixes 52 alias-OOD model-derived confidences (avg ~0.95) with 18 structural abstain confidences (avg 0.058). No-applicable/empty precision 1.0 and ECE therefore not fully model-calibrated. Learned alias-only ECE 0.0407 is clean; overall ECE understates learned calibration contribution.

Both RULE and LEARNED ECE computed over 5 bins have 3 empty bins (bins 1-3 count 0). Bins 0 (18 no-app/empty, acc 0, avg_conf 0.058) and 4 (52 alias+exact, acc 1, avg_conf 0.912 RULE /0.950 LEARNED) carry all mass. ECE = 18/70*0.058 +52/70*|1-avg_conf| =0.0803/0.0518. Bimodal distribution makes ECE threshold 0.15 lenient; different binning or threshold 0.80 sensitivity not tested. LEARNED ECE lacks bootstrap CI for stability claim.
validity_findings.evidence: derived_metrics.json:no_applicable.bins_reconstruction_rule, bins_reconstruction_learned, ece_bootstrap_ci_rule [0.0722,0.0883] vs no learned CI

validity_findings.finding: Train split n=21 tasks (7 per family, is_heldout=False) is leak-free vs held-out 9 and mixed 10 (asserted 0/9,0/10). However train and test are identically distributed by generator (same template families, same base URL set, same registry construction, same derived_state whitelist). Generalization to held-out novel keys (X-Api-Key, X-Auth-Key, Api-Token, api_token, authToken, access_key, permission, etc.) still solved by the generic adopt-any-key-not-in-registry mechanism, not by learning key semantics. Small training horizon (120 epochs, 26s) achieving 40/40 across 3 seeds (CV 0.0) suggests solution is near-deterministic copying, not substantive inductive learning.

Producer discloses compact MLP GRPO adapter ~15k params vs director_mandate primary mechanism LLM-scale GRPO. Frozen spec permits System-One scoring/budget adapter when offline/hosted LLM unavailable, so experiment is spec-compliant, but product consequence 'learnable GRPO can replace hand-coded rules' does not extend to LLM-scale. Training cost/stability reporting (8.5-8.7s/seed, tokens N/A) is not comparable to 300-600k token LLM budget. No evidence about LLM hallucinations, calibration via language, or retrieval+reconstruction verification economics at scale.

All retrieval/verbatim baselines achieve 0/40 alias-OOD correct and verbatim false_accept 1.0, as registry contains exactly one intent-matching mechanism per task with distinct alias template and requires rewriting. Beating 0/40 with copy mechanism does not demonstrate retrieval is hard — TF-IDF/embed are fit on train registry only and intent strings are identical across candidates, so TF-IDF/embed cannot discriminate. 'Not dominated by retrieval' check (RULE/LEARNED 1.0 vs best RAG 0.0 gap 1.0) is tautological under this design; B-RAG-EMBED real retriever (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 220 encodings) 0/40 confirms retrieval alone cannot solve aliasing but not surprising.

Does NOT support live WebShop/ALFWorld BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 CDP AX heterogeneity, mixed multi-channel under noisy DOM, production-SPA heterogeneity, LLM-scale GRPO, or product-core economics; live N=0 exploratory, real alias distribution, calibration under non-bimodal confidence, and retrieval-at-scale (corpus>3) remain unknown.
